title_en: The Deadliest Killers of the Marvel Universe Come Alive In a Stunning Preview of Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room
summary_en: We've got an early look at Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room, a stylish new anthology series from Marvel Comics.
body_en:
Marvel Comics has been keeping the anthology series alive and well in recent years with their various "Black, White & Red" comics. Now it's Black Widow's turn to star in one of these beautiful comics, as Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room celebrates the deadliest assassins to come out of this elite institution.
IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room #1. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room is a four-issue series with three short stories in each issue, one focused on Natasha Romanov, one on Yelena Belova, and one on the history of the Red Room program. The first issue features the following tales:
We can also exclusively reveal the solicitation for Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room #3. Learn more below:
Written by TORUNN GRØNBEKK, OLIVIA CUARTERO-BRIGGS & STEVE FOXE
Art by CHRISTIAN ROSADO, ROBERTA INGRANATA & KYLE CHARLES
COVER BY PHILIP TAN
Dive into the world of Black Widow and the Red Room, beautifully imagined in black, white and red! Fan-favorites Torunn Grønbekk & Christian Rosado expand on a mysterious chapter in Black Widow’s life, Olivia Cuartero-Briggs & Roberta Ingranata team up for a White Widow heist story, and Steve Foxe and Kyle Charles tell a gut-wrenching tale about Niko Constantin — the Wolf Spider!
On Sale 2/24
Black Widow: Black, White & Red Room #1 will be released on December 16. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more, check out IGN's review of The Avengers #1 and get an exclusive preview of Tales of the TMNT: Tear in Time .
